## Geocoding HDB resale data

### Basic version


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
HDBresale <- read_csv(
  "data/rawdata/HDBresale.csv") %>%
  filter(flat_type == "4 ROOM") %>%
  filter(month >= "2025-09" & month < "2025-10")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
HDBresale$street_name <- gsub(
  "ST\\.", "SAINT", 
  HDBresale$street_name)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
geocode <- function(block, streetname) {
  base_url <- "https://onemap.gov.sg/api/common/elastic/search"
  address <- paste(block, streetname, sep = " ")
  query <- list("searchVal" = address, 
                "returnGeom" = "Y",
                "getAddrDetails" = "N",
                "pageNum" = "1")
  
  res <- GET(base_url, query = query)
  restext<-content(res, as="text")
  
  output <- fromJSON(restext)  %>% 
    as.data.frame %>%
    select(results.LATITUDE, results.LONGITUDE)

  return(output)
}
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
HDBresale$LATITUDE <- 0
HDBresale$LONGITUDE <- 0

for (i in 1:nrow(HDBresale)){
  temp_output <- geocode(HDBresale[i, 4], HDBresale[i, 5])
  
  HDBresale$LATITUDE[i] <- temp_output$results.LATITUDE
  HDBresale$LONGITUDE[i] <- temp_output$results.LONGITUDE
}
```
:::


### Robust version.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#-------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#-------------------------------
url <- "https://onemap.gov.sg/api/common/elastic/search"

# adjust these if needed
block  <- names(HDBresale)[4]
street_name <- names(HDBresale)[5]

# add row index for safe join later
HDBresale2 <- HDBresale %>% mutate(.row = row_number())

# output checkpoints
checkpoint_file <- "geocode_checkpoint.csv"
notfound_file   <- "geocode_notfound.csv"

#-------------------------------
# 2. Helper: Geocode one record
#-------------------------------
geocode_one <- function(row_id, block_val, street_val, max_tries = 3) {
  address <- paste(block_val, street_val)
  query <- list(
    searchVal = address,
    returnGeom = "Y",
    getAddrDetails = "N",
    pageNum = "1"
  )
  
  # retry logic with exponential backoff
  for (try in seq_len(max_tries)) {
    res <- try(GET(url, query = query), silent = TRUE)
    
    # failed or bad status
    if (inherits(res, "try-error") || status_code(res) != 200) {
      Sys.sleep(2 ^ try * 0.5)  # wait longer each retry
      next
    }
    
    json <- content(res)
    
    if (!is.null(json$results) && length(json$results) > 0) {
      return(tibble(
        .row = row_id,
        LATITUDE = as.numeric(json$results[[1]]$LATITUDE),
        LONGITUDE = as.numeric(json$results[[1]]$LONGITUDE),
        FOUND = TRUE
      ))
    } else {
      return(tibble(.row = row_id, LATITUDE = NA_real_,
                    LONGITUDE = NA_real_, FOUND = FALSE))
    }
  }
  
  # if all retries failed
  tibble(.row = row_id, LATITUDE = NA_real_, LONGITUDE = NA_real_, FOUND = FALSE)
}

#-------------------------------
# 3. Loop with progress bar + checkpoint
#-------------------------------
n <- nrow(HDBresale2)
pb <- progress_bar$new(format = "  Geocoding [:bar] :percent in :elapsed",
                       total = n, clear = FALSE, width = 60)

results_list <- vector("list", n)

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  pb$tick()
  block_val  <- HDBresale2[[block]][i]
  street_val <- HDBresale2[[street_name]][i]
  
  results_list[[i]] <- geocode_one(i, block_val, street_val)
  Sys.sleep(0.3)  # keep under OneMap rate limit (~3 requests/sec)
  
  # save intermediate results every 100 records
  if (i %% 100 == 0) {
    checkpoint <- bind_rows(results_list[1:i])
    write_csv(checkpoint, checkpoint_file)
  }
}

# combine all results
geocoded <- bind_rows(results_list)

#-------------------------------
# 4. Merge back to original data
#-------------------------------
HDBresale_geo <- HDBresale2 %>%
  left_join(geocoded, by = ".row") %>%
  select(-.row)

#-------------------------------
# 5. Separate not-found addresses
#-------------------------------
not_found <- HDBresale_geo %>% filter(!FOUND)
write_csv(not_found, notfound_file)

#-------------------------------
# 6. Save final output
#-------------------------------
write_csv(HDBresale_geo, "HDBresale_geocoded.csv")

message("✅ Geocoding completed!")
message("📁 Results saved to 'HDBresale_geocoded.csv'")
message("📁 Not found addresses saved to 'geocode_notfound.csv'")
message("💾 Checkpoints saved every 100 records.")
```
